title: 供应商延迟与仓库资金压力
context: 库存＋采购联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年到期采购行，按供应商计算逾期未接收金额；按商品仓库去重后汇总关联期末库存价值，仅纳入该供应商有逾期未足量收货的商品仓库；库存价值无法视为单一供应商独占。
commonError: 跨供应商库存暴露值不可全局相加，可能重叠。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id,SUM((quantity_ordered-accepted)*unit_price_cents) overdue_value FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND quantity_ordered>accepted GROUP BY supplier_id,warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT a.supplier_id,COUNT(*) affected_pairs,SUM(a.overdue_value) overdue_cents,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) exposed_stock_cents FROM a JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=a.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=a.product_id AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY a.supplier_id ORDER BY overdue_cents DESC,a.supplier_id
